meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成分层说明文件,让 AI 编程助手读懂代码结构、命令与约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望 AI 助手在大型代码库里按目录逐步理解项目并遵循团队约定
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to understand a large codebase by directory and follow team conventions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为项目生成分层的 AGENTS.md 知识库:一个根目录文件,加上按复杂度评分选出的子目录文件,内容是该仓库的结构、命令和约定;生成后还会逐个文件校验,最后询问是本地保留还是走 PR 提交。
howto.when: 当某个仓库需要把它的结构、命令和约定记录下来给 agent 用时触发。你输入 /init-deep 即启动,也可带参数如 --create-new、--max-depth=2 等。

say.note: 更新已有 AGENTS.md,并在需要处新建
先读旧的,全部删掉后从零重建

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude generates a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for your repo: a root file plus complexity-scored subdirectory files covering structure, commands, and conventions. It then verifies each file line by line.
howto.when_en: Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents. Run /init-deep, optionally with flags such as --create-new or --max-depth.

say_en.note: Update existing AGENTS.md and create new ones
Read existing, delete all, regenerate from scratch
